summary: Held-out grading harness landed (scripts/bench-heldout.js): prose-only solve worktree (no test/rubric), external post-hoc grader the agent never saw, only arm diff = graph access — fixes the v1-v8 oracle leak. silent-cap: rigging guard DID NOT HOLD (cold reads batch.js + submits one item/call, cap-agnostic → self-contained tasks are structurally un-trappable) → TRAP INVALID, no win, warm not run. task→transcript resolveOwner: rigging guard HELD → WIN — cold (off) 0/5 solved, 0/10 held-out correlation edges every trial (zero variance); warm (on,--consult=search) 7/8 solved, 10/10 edge on 7 trials / 0/10 on 1 (mean 8.8/10). Lone warm miss retrieved the seeded note but failed to apply it (application variance). Corroboration: warm winners write ~4x more code (2.7k vs 0.7k chars). FIRST valid win in 9 attempts: retrieved context proven load-bearing under blind cold + fair grading. Verdict note-mq7xridg4tn; memory note appended; results in bench/heldout/.
